desc: Precompute smallest prime factor (SPF) up to 1000.
Factorize each A_i; collect exponent list per prime across all A_i.
For each prime p, build array e_i (size N-1), compute M = sum(e_i).
Precompute powers p^k mod MOD for k=0..M.
Initialize dp arrays (size M+1): dp1[0]=1, others 0; dp0 is all zeros.
Implement DP for positions 1..N: for each step i from 1 to N-1, update dp based on e_i, correctly handling zero seen flag and weight p^{x_i}.
After processing all N-1 steps, the answer for prime p is sum of dp1[x] for x in [0..M] (since we need at least one zero among the N elements).
Verify the DP by testing on the sample inputs.
If any sample fails, debug carefully (e.g., check boundary conditions, off-by-one errors, handling of e_i=0).
